title: 3DO DevBench — Console
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: Status pills
items.text: Run mode (running / paused), guest frame counter and CPU state (running, or HALTED in red at a breakpoint).

items.label: Run controls
items.text: Run (real time), Turbo, Pause, +1 frame / +60, CPU halt (debugger freeze), Reset and Reboot for the selected session.

items.label: Debug console
items.text: The 3DO debug console live: kernel boot, then everything the program prints with printf/kprintf/tdo_log (KEEP: room …); layer lines dimmed, errors red (MCP: emu_log).

items.label: Filter & follow
items.text: Filter the console text; follow keeps it scrolled to the end.

items.label: Session events
items.text: Breakpoints hit, resets, reboots and crashes.
